trigger: Under the overpass: Wes is hit.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Wes is under the overpass in a puddle of slush, holding his thigh. There's a lot of blood. Too much.

nodes.speaker: wes
nodes.text: Hey. Hey, big brother. I'm fine. This is fine. I'm so fine.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Lying against Wes's side. Keeping him warm. Not moving.]

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: He's Compact. If my people find him, he's a detainee. If he's a detainee, he's a number.

choices.text: [Med kit. Treat him. He comes with me]

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: ...I didn't see a Compact fighter. I saw a mechanic's brother. Go. Before I see him.

nodes.speaker: wes
nodes.text: Dad's gonna kill you for this. Then hug you. Then kill you again.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You carry him across no man's land with your hands up. The Compact lets you through. Ross takes him from you.

nodes.speaker: ross
nodes.text: ...Thank you, son. Go back. Before someone shoots you for walking both ways.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: I'll get him a medic. I'll try to get him a good one. That's all I can promise.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The convoy's lights move west. The canyon goes back to the dark.
